company_info.company_description: "Keen 2B Green Pty Ltd is a specialist supplier of solar power technology and other environmentally-friendly solutions. It provides products to homes and businesses throughout the Gold Coast and Brisbane.The local company retails, wholesales and installs quality grid-connected solar power systems available and prides itself on providing personalised customer service. Efforts are made to find the best possible solar panels that meet the requirements and budget of the customer.Keen 2B Green Pty Ltd also offers the latest information on available government rebates and incentives to help lower the cost of installing solar power systems."

reviews.review_description: Our solar panels are not working so I have contacted with them many times and leave the message but did not get back from them ...not answering the phone no returning calls...my solar still under warranty....
Poor after sales service from Fronius
Installation team were polite, quick and cleaned up all their mess.
Sales process was very smooth. Installation in progress, weeks earlier than quoted.
I have used this provider since 2016 and they haven't failed at any level thus far.

Sales and quoting for very good.  Sold us just what was needed in 2014.Installation was seamless.   Punctual, tidy and always polite.Customer service was excellent.    Organised everything perfectly.Much to my surprise I had a fault on one system end of 2022 and keen2bgreen were quick to send me a friendly greeting and  inform me of the fault with suggestions to rectify.    Once I followed instructions and reported back that I was unable to resolve issue, Keen2BGreen were quick to come to site and quick to replace the faulty part with a warranty replacement.    Very professional and kind.

After doing 18 months extensive research, Keen2BGreen delivered the 6.4kW system that I requested and followed my instructions on the inverter location etc.The installation and communication from start to finish including paperwork was first class.In addition they are certified partners with both Fronius and REC plus a local Gold Coast company.

Got our system (6.32Kw) installed in Jan 2014.  Great service and professional install. Had not one issue since installing in 20214. Was honest with figures, esp payback (they were spot on) - many charlatans back then quoting mythical figures. Will use them for our upgrade.

Keen 2B Green were very helpful and professional from the start.  All my questions were answered in consultation, they were responsive and reliable and helped me tweak the system to my needs to make sure it was the right size and type for me.  The guys on install day showed up on time in spite of questionable weather, went over and above to get the job done, were flexible with my specific requirements and did a very neat and tidy install job, I'm very impressed.  Now that it's installed I have full visibility over how much power the system produces and how much the battery stores, it's very easy.  My expectations have been met and exceeded.  These guys definitely got it right for me.
Excellent personalised quoting. Beautiful installation. And great customer service! I recommend them to all friends and family!

I found them to be an excellent company to work with. extra attention to detail and top quality products quoted and at a comparable price to some "lower quality" products offered through other companies.I ended up paying extra (above what was offered through other companies) for an even better quality system that still fit my budget.

Didn't end up using one of the three solar companies that where recommended. Did find another Company that ended up being $700.00 cheaper than one of the Companies priced on the same System. Couldn't be happier with their Service,in constant contact every step of the process from first contact to the install and arranging the final Meter change over.Highly Recommended. System up and Running!
This price I paid was a promotional price they had and I paid +1.5k to upgrade the inverter to GEN24.I wish I went with a bigger system though.
Yes they have organised the grid connect . Based on my research I feel the system I chose was good.
Great service from the time they did a site visit to when I recommended them to friends.

The company I chose was local and uses LG solar panels which have one of the better industry names and warranty.  The sales person was personable and kept his presentation simple and easy to understand. Although not the cheapest,  I felt very comfortable with their offer and the after sales service has been great. The installer's were efficient and tidy,  the connection to the grid was straight forward, the app is easy to follow, and I know I can phone them to help me if I have any queries moving forward.
From go to whoa Keen2bGreen were excellent as is now their after sales service

From the initial meeting onsite to the installation and after service paperwork Keen 2B Green have excelled.Having done a bit of homework on the solarqoutes website I was able to work with K2BG and now have a system that meets my needs and my budget. (LG Panels, Solaredge Inverter, smart meter and hot water relay)The process has been smooth from start to finish.This is a company you can trust.

Mark Reynolds ,the sales consultant, knows his stuff.Very impressed.The girls in the office kept in touch so we knew when things were happening.The installers turned up on time and got stuck into my job with ease.My first impression was how neat they were dressed and big smiles.They had to carry lots of product up onto the 2nd storey roof on a ladder.Wow!!!!! They did not take a break till they had completed the job.After they finished they cleaned up all the rubbish and took it away.
Quoting was quick and efficientinstallation was hassle free and neatly done

Fantastic process all the way through. I had already received a few quotes and had been told some mixed information. K2bG took the time to explain everything, brought up potential issues others had avoided (meterbox and toilet pipe on roof). They were fast and effective on the day.The work was quality, in particular the cable management it looked professional. They worked hard in the heat. Afterwards the administration team sent the request to Energex and have assured me to contact them when my provider installs a smart meter and they will walk me through everything again if I need it. Very happy

I would like to thank Keen 2B Green for their professional approach to my quote/ installation and after sales service to get connected to the grid everything went very smoothly everything was done on time as they say it would be and their office staff were very helpful with questions that I had I would like to recommend them  in regards to solar installation

The sales/quoting process was quick and easy with replies/quotes generally same day. Communication and booking for the install was easy, even allowed us to book 8 weeks out from accepting the quote. We specifically wanted LG panels, Enphase inverters and to use a large section of our south facing roof with tilt frames. We knew this was not a cheap personal decision however given their buying power with LG and Enphase, they came out cheaper when compared to other quotes for the exact same system.Installation was prompt, everyone arrived exactly on time and got straight to work. During the layout phase, they did notice some potential shading from another section of the roof. This was explained to us and we made a decision to move some of the panels. I'm really glad that they took the time to perform some investigation prior to commencing the install, have a quick conversation with us and willing to make some changes on the day. The change process was effortless and we're better off as a result.After install customer service was great. We were provided with all the paper work on the day with an explanation of the installation. The next day, all our remote monitoring details were sent to us and we received a friendly phone call afterwards to make sure everything was okay.I generally don't write reviews but I genuinely think one is warranted in this case.

After talking with Mark it was clear that keen 2B green were more experienced then other providers we had spoken to. Mark suggested a system that we were very happy with and within our price range, he also gave gave good advice to install and energy meter and hot water relay which no other provider mentioned. The install team did a great job. I am an experienced tradesman myself and after viewing the quality workmanship they provided I was very impressed, they also cleaned up very well. The hand over process was clear and easy and no question was off the table. Over all the team from Keen 2B green did a fantastic job.

Mat from Keen2BGreen visited the house and talked me through all the options and his recommendations. He was very knowledgeable and professional. He provided several quotes and also let me know a few days later when a new promotion started.The installation team were punctual, courteous and professional. They helped arrange grid connection. The office team were also very helpful.
After the initial quote from Matthew he was always available and helpful with further questions and options.  Installation was completed without issues - Overall customer service has been fantastic
all good, I'd recommend them, they covered all bases, did what they said, when they said

One needs to compare apples with apples. Your website, solarquotes, was very informative in comparing various panels and inverters. Numerous companies tried to sell us cheaper panels with a our preferred invented. Keen2B were very patient, didn't try to upsell and were also very honest about panel output, inverter and turnaround time. The whole process was very professional and proficient with frequent communication and updates. Our Fronius inverter also came with an extended warranty, as they are a preferred partner.

Got the Keen 2B Green from the SolarQuotes website as a trusted provider / installer.The quotes from the three installers provided by Solarqoutes were timely and were all comparable price wise so I went with a brand name that I knew (LG) for the solar panels.  Again this was all from the research done through your web site.  Inverter was a Fronius Primo.Extremely happy with the process as it certainly made my life easier.Thanks Solarquotes

Matthew (Salesperson) and Shari (Office based Support) from Keen 2B Green were absolute delightful and professional people to deal with.In summary I was supplied with an absolute quality system, at a competitive price, fit for purpose and to cover my energy needs.  Matthew forecasted my current needs and also did some forecasting of my future needs.  He ensured he incorporated easily and in a cost effective manner, the ability to expand the system if I decide to go into a home based AirBnB or have Family come to live.Matthew was patient with me whilst I undertook a lot of research, got other quotes and always answered every question I had.  Shari followed up with wonderful office based support and continues to check in with me now of the performance of the system.  Absolute dedication to Customer service throughout every step.I need to add that my Son is a Research and Development Engineer with a Defence Company and is the technical know with Solar Systems.  When he saw what had installed, he was very impressed and said "Mum this Company has done an excellent and honest job for you!"  My Son wanted Keen 2B Green's contact details as he will also be recommending them to his Colleagues based in Brisbane.  I am based on the Sunshine Coast and I highly recommend Keen 2B Green!

The salesman Matt was great at explaining the products best suited to my property and electrical usage.He arranged one of the electricians to come out prior to install to complete a full measure up and check out the condition of the roof due to the age of my house.The installation team were punctual and did a fantastic job of keeping everything neat and tidy as well communicating with me throughout the process as requested so I was up to date.Monitoring was set up the next day and Shari from the office ran me through the specifics so I could view my system online and be confident to do so.You can't fault this company if you want a clean nice no fuss installation.
Sales person good,installation good, monitoring of the system not yet completed ,grid connection not completed (no copy of any paperwork (ready for test to energex) that was expected.

My solar installation was completed by Keen2BGreen (K2BG) in 2016.  I contacted K2BG 16/10/19 for quote for cleaning and inspection of possible panel damage.  Contacted K2BG again to request quote.  Was informed job could not be done for 4-6 weeks.  Another company completed this job.  Contacted K2BG 3 more times in an attempt to receive a quote for replacement panel.  Received a verbal quote but did not receive a written quote as promised.  Another company completed the replacement.   Very poor customer support!

After speaking with 4 suppliers we decided on Keen 2B green. They installed our first system 10 years ago at our previous home. They provided the sharpest price and the best advice regarding panel placement, inverter type and racking options. It's a complicated process to choose a good installer (and good panels and racking) but the SolarQuotes website helped immensely. The advice available on this site ensured that we have a reliable system at a competitive price.

Fantastic company to deal with that I canâ€™t recommend highly enough!From the beginning, Mark, was very patient and helpful with the quoting process and we were able to design a system which best suits our needs at a good price.Chris, their supervisor electrician, made a visit prior to install to go over some of the more technical details and was happy to provide advice and recommendations on the upgrade to 3 phase power, battery, and inverter setup for our solar system.The team of installers/electricians, lead by Matt, were very accommodating and were able to install our system to a very high professional standard and to my specifications for position of the equipment.Chris was also very helpful and knowledgeable in the use of the applications which control and monitor the solar, after install support, and also dealt directly with the manufacturer.Keen 2B Green is such an exceptional company to deal with that they have now installed a solar system at my parents house and are pending an install at my brother-in-lawâ€™s home.FYI: my system consists of 9.45 KW REC solar panels with Enphase microinverters, upgrade to three phase, and a Tesla Power Wall 2 with Backup Gateway 2.

After a lot of research, decided to go with Keen 2B Green largely due to their experience, other reviews and quality products. Being a premier LG supplier they can provide one of the best panels at a competitive price.  I decided to go with LG 340W panels due to the full 25 year warranty and Fronius inverter. The system is 7.48 kW capacity and we added a smart meter so we can monitor usage and run reports.Sales process was easy but artsy as I knew what I wanted.  Professional quote detailing estimated system output, good use of Near maps to show how the panels would look and to identify potential shading (eg: stink pipe that was cut down during installation).A few issues during installation but were sorted out promptly. Installation crew were great and cleaned up after finishing.There is good back office support.Exceptional performance of the LG panels and Fronius inverter considering ours is an East - West orientation.Would certainly recommend Keen 2B Green to anyone.

Everything about K2BG was very professional.Granted, price was higher than most, but the service was top notch and the system is great.We got a 20 panel LG NeON2 330W system attached to a Fronius 5KW inverter.Everything is working a real treat and the system is going well.

I had a 6.6 kw system installed not long ago and couldn't be happier! From the initial conversation with Matt to sorting out some small issues. Matt, the sales person has answered my questions with a high level of professionalism. No BS involved, sales pitches just straight up numbers and facts! I did a lot of research on my own so knew a bit of what he was talking about.  The price was really good, competitive and he's always sent me the quote when he promised he will!On the installation day, the team did a great job! Tidy, clean,  all up and running. There was a small issue, but it has been sorted out within less than hour by their Project  Team Manager, Chris. The inverter was installed very tidy.After the install, they proceeded with the paperwork to have it hooked up to the network, which has progressed well so far!Also hooked up to the monitoring tools provided, within a day!I wish more companies, not only in solar would have their work ethic and customer oriented attitude from top to bottom!
They are a company that goes by word of mouth and had 3 very reliable colleagues they have used this company and were very impressed with all aspects of their services. As are we

I spent a lot of time researching equipment and installers and decided to go with this company because of their customer service record. They have been a huge disappointment. The sales rep didn't assess the roof properly for the installation or the trees surrounding the house. There was no suggestion of optimisers or racking. The installers rushed the installation and couldn't put the panels where they were meant to go. The system (5.12kw) produced 6kwh (estimate was 15) a day through winter if we were lucky. It took them a year from when the system was installed to come and do anything about it (even tho they came to the property three times to look at it and make an 'assessment') They finally came and moved half the panels onto racking. The guys who came were brusque and rushed again. I would have preferred for them to move all the panels. The system did pick up its output after this but there was no follow up from them at all. Almost a year later and we are lucky if the system hits 4000watts during summer.
They didt offer the smart meter in the quote or as an option to keep price down. I was luck a competitor told me. They were still the best price for what I bought.

We went for this company because it was a local company that had the product that we required. We had a lot of quotes and most of them were fantastic as well. But taking into all the information we accumulated over a three week period and studying the advise that you had on the internet which was fantastic advise, we decided that this was the company that we wanted to use. Without your help and expertise we would still be struggling. We have solar installed and went with LG panels and a Fronius inverter. To us it was the best combination. Thank you for all the help and we were so glad to have been able to use you for advice.Regards Mark & Karen Young

6.6kW of Qcells 275 W PV panels and a Fronius 5 kW inverter.Responsive sales person to provide a suitable quote. Helpful admin to manage and arrange installation.Friendly and efficient installers.I Do have an outstanding problem with AGL on removal of controlled load meter but Keen2BGreen currently following this up on my behalf.
100kw Solar Edge system with 400w LG panels very happy with Keen2BGreen would happily recommend.

I was happy with with this company until the actual installation of the panels on the roof mounts. They didn't bother to take the time to cut the cable ties holding the connection wires on the back of the panels instead they just yanked on the wires until the cable ties snapped, very rough! When they were securing the panels to the mounts they leaned on the glass front of the panel as they reached over to tighten the bolts on the mounts which made the panels flex quite a bit, in the manufacturers documentation it clearly states not to do this as it can cause damage. When I raised concerns about this I was told it would be ok. Less than happy with this.

I suggest that anyone thinking solar should consider obtaining a quote from Keen 2B Green. We decided on a Fronius inverter with the smart meter, and REC panels mounted on the Radiant racking system. Our experience was great, from the initial conversation through to installation and connection to solar.web. I genuinely believe Keen 2B Green went out of their way to make sure we were very happy customers!
Professional,  knowledgeable, efficient.

Id like to say that they made the whole process painless and the guys cleaned up after themselves plus the sales person did the best I think to give a very good quote and to do what he could to give us the service we required. Also the girls at the office set up the system at their end and made it real easy too.Geoff

We did pay 28 thousand dollars for a 10 kW system , they promised the world and delivered nothing , the work took much longer than they promised.They were so incompetent after 5-6 weeks of the installation we are still not connected to the grid . They blame Origin , Origin blame Energex , Energex blame Origin!

Only one of three companies that insisted on a home visit and inspection before they would provide a quote. Although they had a quote ready with them based on previous telephone conversation. The customer service is good so far. Awaiting the electricity supplier approval to go ahead with the install hopefully at the end of Nov 2017.
Brilliant experience all round. The 10 kW system is pumping out good numbers, the products are great as is the customer service - very happy customer.

Of the three that quoted through your website, only Hawking listened to what I wanted. I wanted a quote on a 3-4kW system. Being just before Christmas, Hawking called as I was signing 27th Keen 2B Green. He was still very helpful and even commented that we were getting a good deal. I would have gone with him but his specifications for panels were not as good a quality as the REC that we installed.Thank you

As new and inexperienced solar purchasers we found the information and links to other websites on the solarquotes website very helpful and even requested some technical assistance via email which was provided quickly and was also very helpful. All 3 referrals from solarquotes.com.au contacted us promptly and visited us at home to inspect our property and recommend a solar system. All 3 visits and quotes were worthwhile and we had intended on going with one of these referrals. However, while undertaking online research about solar panel brands prior to making our decision, we came across numerous references to another local installation company Keen 2B Green who also had many favourable reviews and decided to speak with them also before making our decision. We found them able to provide a quality system with LG panels and Fronius inverter and a quality installation at a competitive price combined with outstanding customer service and were very comfortable with dealing with them. Our solar system was installed just over a week ago and we are very happy with the system and installation and the followup service to date.
Only one company contacted me from your site. I had to go get my own independent quotes.

After only one of the companies from solarquotes got in contact with us we started looking for our own quotes. We found this company as they came highly recommended on the whirlpool forums.I rang them up and a consultant was at our house the next day to talk with us. He was great at answering all of our questions and was able to put together a system that met our requirements and didn't blow the budget.We paid our deposit on a Thursday and the team were out to install it on Monday! All three of the boys knew what they were doing and were able to have everything up and running within hours. They left our place tidy and the installation was very neat.Even the girls in the office were great at getting in contact with us as soon as we had sent the email with the signed quote. We were called to explain the next steps, confirm an install date, tell us who the installer would be and answer any further questions we had. We then got a follow up call the day before the installation to reiterate the previous call.Overall our experience has been nothing but great. We will not hesitate to recommend Keen 2B Green to anyone!

We found Keen 2B Green via whirlpool forums. Their system setup was the same as MC Electrical (LG Neon 2 panels with Fronius inverter) but was cheaper and they were able to install it sooner.  MC Electrical were our second choice.

This company is more professional than the other 2 companies I received quotes from.They replied very quickly to my enquiryThey already had aerial images of my roofThey talked about the best location of the panelsand  Informed me of the various Panels and inverters available for the size I required.

I found the reviews in the solar choice websites really valuable to compare the components used you various suppliers. I settled for Trina honey panels (with a very good efficiency rating for Australian conditions) and an Austrian inverter with capacity to upgrade to battery storage.

After getting your quotes, I read feedbacks from customers who had used this company and all their comments were positive and said what a great company they were which proved to be correct. They let me decide when I wanted to install the system and did not pressurise me like one of the companies you referred to me. Also the salesperson had the time to visit my home and explain every detail to me. Out of the 3 referrals you sent, only one salesperson came to my home. The other two did it by phone and had no idea of really what the layout of my home was and could not be bothered to come visit my home.

Very impressed with your site and the information available.Unfortunately the response time from the 3 installers was over 1 week so I approached keen2bgreen after reading good things about them on the Whirlpool forums.I made the decision on a Friday and system was installed the following Wednesday.Jim the sales rep from K2gb was fantastic as was Chantelle the office manager and Brent and the boys did a great job installing. They even stayed at our house until 7.15pminstalling a smart meter and had a 2 hour drive back to the Gold Coast.
Very prompt, good people.I was connected to the web before the install was finished.
Their sales, service, installation was 9 out of 10.

I decided to go with keen 2B geen, based at Burleigh heads because of product name recognition & price range that was within my affordability. they were professional, prompt & the installation was perfect, no broken tiles on my roof during installation. if you are looking to get a solar power system installed, I highly recommend keen2bgreen..

Used solarquotes to receive my first 3 quotes. Had 2 sales people come out from Mark Group and CSA, seemed they had limited information and just wanted to push products. Only one came back with a written quote, never heard from the second and the third company wanted to quote over email using near maps.Jim from K2BGreen was fantastic, informative and open to my ideas and suggestions.Installers were good on the day, took the best part of the day to install the system, clean install, no conduit, placed panels as asked, meter box neat and tidy. Broke 3-4 tiles, but replaced with my spare stock which is a fantastic effort for a 30 year old roof.Some problems setting up Flukso meter initially, but Chris returned later that week and got everything set up. Outputting to http://pvoutput.org/list.jsp?userid=38891.Overall would thoroughly recommend K2BGreen or Positronics if in QLD!

I was looking for very specific things - a 5kW system with micro inverter technology.   From the SolarQuote webpages and other sites I'd determined that the most highly recommended solar panels were LG and the inverter SMA however it became apparant the this was also the most expensive combination.   Alas most quotes provided seemed to ignore this request and just quote on the most commonly supplied systems from their perspective.Keen 2B Green however did supply the LG option in their quote but also offered other well regarded/recommended alternatives.   They were prompt in responding & when I did speak to their sales guy he was very obliging in giving me comparisons for different configurations & answering all my random questions.    Due to my work constraints they also were very obliging in fitting me in during my R&R window (with relatively short notice) and the installation guys were perfectly polite and consciencious of doing a good job and spotless clean up at the end of the day.Sadly a local supplier (REA Global sole supplier of LG systems) came through the website as an alternative supplier lead on the day I signed with K2BG which I would have really liked to had given an oppotunity to quote.   K2BG I was sure was recommended through SC however not one of the 3 listed however would happily recommend them to anyone considering installing solar power to either home or business.

Highly recommend Keen 2B Green, in Brisbane. One Chinese company gave me a really good price, when I didn't choose them for some reason, they called me a few times to say something bad about Keen 2B Green.

We received the three quotes from the website but were unhappy with each for different reasons.  The choice was extremely difficult - all companies had different products that they recommended, and they all expressed concerns about the competitor products.  One salesperson in particular had a spiel that they would not be distracted from despite the fact that we had extensively researched the market and just wanted specific questions answered.  Two were extremely negative about "other solar companies", despite the fact that we had already said that we were not getting quotes from the sorts of companies that give away free TVs etc. The quotes we received mostly lacked sufficient detail and we were not comfortable about any of the recommended three.After more research we contacted Keen 2B Green and the process was much more as it should have been: a fully detailed quote, no extreme pressure, minimal sledging of other companies.  They had good reviews both on this site and elsewhere.  The installation was very good.  It's a bit too early to discuss the impact of the system: it has only been installed for about 3 weeks and we won't get a bill for another 2 months.

I would highly reccommend this company----they were on time  and very presentably dressed---very knowlegable   presented plans where panels were to be situated---shifted whirlybirds at no expense----very courteous and everything fully explained--company kept in contact  and kept us vey well informed---all in all a very good experience
Quick and easy. No sales gimmicks
My neighbour referred me to Keen 2B Green. They were very prompt for an onsite quote. In fact, of the three companies recommended through your service, none could make it inside a 2 week period.

We found Keen2B Green professional from the start to finish. From initial contact to installation and after installation service was of the highest quality. Very friendly and competent, would have no problem recommending them.

The installers were very professional and took care to ensure that they explained all process to me. They were also very neat and cleaned up the site after working there.They arrived on time and were very friendly.VERY PROFESSIONAL INDEED

It was a toss up between CSA and Keen2Bgreen as both were very professional in their approach to the quote. Mark Group would only quote if I was definitely going to buy. Other quote was on a piece of plain paper. So neither of these considered. Installation went well with good attention to detail. Am now waiting for Energex to connect us to the grid.
Really can not fault the team, pre and post installation has been top notch

Staff gave excellent initial advice on the selection and placement of panels and inverter for our new house. They liaised well with our builder, and kept us regularly updated on the progress of installation of our system. Keen 2B Green has been a pleasure to deal with.
Narrowed it down to the two companies in Brisbane with the best reviews and chose them because I feel their product was slightly better than my other chosen company.  Excellent all round experience.
Very professional installers, very tidy installation. No rubbish left around. Excellent customer service.

Good communication throughout.  There was a small delay with poor weather but the guys still installed the inverter one day and then the panels when it was fine.  I was kept in the loop with rescheduling.\r\nPrompt service. Neat and tidy install.  Great price.  Lovely, friendly and knowledgeable people to deal with.\r\nOverall a very positive experience.
I have no hesitation in recommending Keen2B green for your Solar issues
Honestly some of the nicest people that I have ever dealt with.

Overall I have found Daniel very helpful both prior to and after agreeing to purchase the system. I was contacted and advised as to when the install would happen and the installers turned up as promised and were very professional.
Very professional. Awesome installation. Best quality components.

3 major factors guided my decision for supplier:-  the supplier responded to specific questions within my timeframe (indicator of customer service)-  had very good reputation on whirlpool forum-  quality and reputaion of system componentsHowever, I was satisfied with the overall service provided by solarquotes.com.au and response by your service providers / suppliers.
Company was great to deal with. Prompt and has efficient service.

I found solarquotes.com.au on the internet, I used your website for weeks learning about, what the salesman were telling me. I checked the panels, outputs, inverter and installers all on your site. It really was a great help. For anyone looking at solar, it should be your first stop.

From the 3 companies that Solar Quotes provided, only 1 came back quickly with a quote.Contact from the other 2 companies took several weeks.When I started asking questions of the one that did come back quickly, their response was much slower and did not fill me with confidence.So I read much of the information provided by Solar Quotes, and this was invaluable in knowing what questions to ask and what to look for in a system. I would highly recommend Solar Quotes for the information provided, even though the referred suppliers did not live up to the same standard.Armed with the information from Solar Quotes I then got quotes from 4 other suppliers that I found. From these quotes I asked questions of the relevant suppliers and gauged their answers.Some were way over priced and 1 was offering poor quality systems.I picked the supplier I felt most comfortable with for quality of the system and price, and got themto do a site visit.I was so impressed with the information they provided and the answers provided that I then wentwith that supplier. They spent 1.5 hours on a free site visit just answering all my questions.They were great, and made every so simple.I can highly recommend Keen2BGreen as a supplier and their follow up service was amazing.Best of luck to all looking for a system, there can be a lot of confusing information, but I canhighly recommend Keen2BGreen and also the information provided by the Solar Quotes siteand Finn Peacock emails as mentioned above.

sales rep knowledgeable and helpful (answered all sorts of stupid questions we had) - installed within time-frame quoted - paper work to us quickly - reminder phone call pre install - phone call after install to check our experience with installers
